fragments.title: Shipping Schedule Discrepancy
fragments.summary: A ledger page showing Corridor East tonnage that does not match the courtesy schedule circulated to Ministry liaisons.

claims.text: Declared tonnage for the 14th differs from liaison schedule by 2,400 units.
Initials consistent with Edrin Voss appear on the correction margin.

fragments.title: Guest List Cipher Scratch
fragments.summary: Pencil marks on a spare seating chart mapping three guests to shipping codes — including a slot aligned with Voss's table.

claims.text: Table 3 cipher cluster matches Voss seating and a shipping lane code.
A second cluster may tag an unlisted operative — possibly Sera Kade.

fragments.title: Pim's Loud Theory
fragments.summary: Pim Orel insists the tonnage 'error' is a catering joke and Voss merely collects signatures for sport.

claims.text: The discrepancy is theatrical — no real goods moved.
Voss signs everything; it means nothing.

fragments.title: Voss Identification
fragments.summary: Corroborated identification of Lord Edrin Voss — appearance, retinue, and political orbit.

claims.text: The host circulating porcelain introductions is Lord Edrin Voss.

fragments.title: Sera's Competing Brief
fragments.summary: A half-smile and a question too precise: Sera Kade is fishing the same pond.

claims.text: Another operative seeks the shipping discrepancy tonight.

fragments.title: Maris's Policy Aside
fragments.summary: Maris mentions Observatory Circle pressure on corridor reporting — not proof, but a motive-shaped shadow.

claims.text: Observatory Circle is leaner on corridor opacity this season.
